Subject: IgniteHub pilot — proposed scope, kickoff window, and weekly gates

Hi Asha / Marco —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed structure for the pilot so we can lock dates and owners:

Scope (what we'll validate)
- Live inference for search-ranking reranks and short-form content suggestions (top-3 model variants).
- Throughput target: 200 qps sustained, 500 qps burst.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for ranking endpoint.

Success criteria (proposed, see attached spreadsheet for metrics):
- Relevance uplift >= 7% (A/B vs baseline) on weekly evaluation sets.
- Average inference cost per 1k requests <= $X (we'll refine with sampling).
- No data exfiltration concerns — all traffic goes through Dedicated instance in our US region.

Timeline / milestones (proposed)
- Kickoff & environment access: week of Dec 14 (kickoff call + credentials).
- Week 1: model onboarding + warmup tests.
- Weeks 2–3: integration & baseline comparisons; daily syncs optional.
- Week 4: full traffic shadowing & evaluation; final readout end of week 4.

Weekly cadence: 30-minute check-ins every Tuesday (standup + blockers).
Owners:
- Redwood technical lead: Rafael Mendes (SE) — model onboarding & performance tuning.
- Redwood PM: Naomi Feldman — timeline, success metrics, stakeholder comms.
- IgniteHub engineering lead: Marco Diaz — integration and sample data.

Next steps (please reply with):
1) Confirm kickoff week (dec 14 works for us) and preferred timezone.
2) Ownership confirm (if someone else on your side should be the primary).
3) Any additional success metrics to add to the attached spreadsheet.

Attachments: IgniteHub_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (xlsx), RI_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Thanks Naomi — this is very clear and close to what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Kickoff week: Dec 14 works for us; prefer mornings PST (9–11am).
- Success metric: add "time-to-first-meaningful-suggestion" (median) as a secondary metric — product cares about perceived latency.
- Security: our security/compliance team will need the Dedicated instance IP range and the SOC2 summary to complete a short questionnaire before kickoff (we'll loop them in once dates are confirmed).
- Procurement: legal will need a short SOW + quote to start the purchase order — can you send the SOW + pricing sheet?

We confirm primary owners: Marco will be the engineering point; I'll handle product/metrics.

Looking forward to the kickoff.
